title: TURKEY'S
10 BIGGEST
CITIES

hook.say: Turkey's ten biggest cities, ranked. Number one is bigger than the next three combined!

outro.say: Is your city on the list? Comment below!

outroLines: IS YOUR CITY ON THE LIST?

items.name: Kocaeli
items.say: Number ten: Ko-jah-elly, Turkey's industrial engine. Two-point-one-six million people.
items.cap: Number ten: Kocaeli, Turkey's industrial engine. 2.16 million people.

items.name: Gaziantep
items.say: Nine: Gahzee-ahntep, the capital of baklava. Two-point-two-two million people.
items.cap: Nine: Gaziantep, the capital of baklava. 2.22 million people.

items.name: Şanlıurfa
items.say: Eight: Shanluh-Urfa, home of the world's oldest temple. Two-point-two-seven million people.
items.cap: Eight: Şanlıurfa, home of the world's oldest temple. 2.27 million people.

items.name: Adana
items.say: Seven: Adana, famous for its kebab. Two-point-two-eight million people.
items.cap: Seven: Adana, famous for its kebab. 2.28 million people.

items.name: Konya
items.say: Six: Konya, city of the whirling dervishes. Two-point-three-four million people.
items.cap: Six: Konya, city of the whirling dervishes. 2.34 million people.

items.name: Antalya
items.say: Five: Ahn-tahl-ya, the Turkish Riviera. Two-point-seven-eight million people.
items.cap: Five: Antalya, the Turkish Riviera. 2.78 million people.

items.name: Bursa
items.say: Four: Bursa, the first Ottoman capital. Three-point-two-six million people.
items.cap: Four: Bursa, the first Ottoman capital. 3.26 million people.

items.name: İzmir
items.say: Three: Izmeer, pearl of the Aegean. Four-point-five million people.
items.cap: Three: İzmir, pearl of the Aegean. 4.5 million people.

items.name: Ankara
items.say: Two: Ankara, the capital. Five-point-nine-one million people.
items.cap: Two: Ankara, the capital. 5.91 million people.

items.name: İstanbul
items.say: And number one: Istanbul! Fifteen-point-seven-five million people, on two continents.
items.cap: And number one: İstanbul! 15.75 million people, on two continents.
